codex_menu.doc: The lore codex menu (M3-UI-03; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Lore codex). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3 so every edge lands on a whole pixel at 1280 x 720. 'categories' (left) and 'entries' (middle) are MenuPage metrics blocks (the same keys as battle_hud.json commands); 'entries' is titled with the category and its count. 'text' is the page on the right: the entry's title (title_height), a dim line under it (sub_height), then the body, clipped to the page and scrolled by scroll_step_px per wheel notch or Page Up / Page Down; a thumb_px bar on its right edge shows where you are when it scrolls. canvas_layer: the bestiary's, over the field menu's 60.

codex_notice.doc: M3-UI-03: the notice in the field when a record is found (an Interactable whose payload is {"record": "<codex id>"}). The TipCard look, at the lower right: a gold page glyph, 'Record added to the Codex', and the record's title. It fades in over fade_sec, holds hold_sec, and fades out; a second record waits its turn. Like the tip card it hides, with its clock stopped, while the field refuses input or a menu pauses the tree. Rect x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference (multiples of 3).
